title: Enabling Robust Cloth Manipulation via Inference-Time Simulator-in-the-Loop Refinement
abstract: A simulator-in-the-loop framework that brings inference-time physics refinement to real-world cloth manipulation from a single RGB observation. Three pillars: (i) FLASH-based scalable synthetic-data generation and inference-time rollout pipeline for deformable objects; (ii) an RGB-native real-to-sim module trained purely on synthetic data that maps a single RGB image to simulation-compatible cloth state by fusing frozen DINOv2 features with learnable canonical tokens; (iii) prior-guided MPPI that couples a sparse-mesh rollout backend with sampling-based optimization anchored at an offline-distilled policy trajectory. Real-robot experiments show higher success rates and stronger robustness than baselines.
